subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so should the accepted path be a default-off KaTeX/MathJax config surface with dependency and sanitizer review?
rationale: The feature is useful for scientific chat workflows, but it adds a core UI dependency, public config contract, and untrusted-rendering sanitizer surface that automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one current KaTeX/MathJax PR or replacement to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, existing-markdown regression coverage, and real Control UI proof.

options.title: Defer pending an extension seam
options.body: Keep the issue open as product backlog and first design a plugin/UI extension path if maintainers do not want this in core.

options.title: Decline first-party math rendering
options.body: Close this issue and the candidate PRs as not planned if the dependency and sanitizer cost is not worth carrying in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one current KaTeX/MathJax PR or replacement to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, existing-markdown regression coverage, and real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has original chat-rendering history plus adjacent product/config/dependency ownership signals for deciding whether this belongs in core.
